skill_name: Evaluate the performance of a conversational AI assistant.
workflow: The performance of a conversational AI assistant can be evaluated in a variety of ways, such as by measuring its accuracy, speed, complexity, and language usage. Accuracy is an important measure, as it gauges how accurately the assistant can understand and answer its users' queries. Speed is also an important aspect, as people expect to receive quick responses. Complexity should be analyzed to ensure the assistant can understand complex requests and tasks.
